notes.title: My game's sales wrap up on August 27
notes.notes: [p]Friends, I would like to inform you that on August 27, exactly on the day of creation of my game, I will stop selling it. Thank you to everyone who supported the project and played it! It was a valuable experience for me, and I really appreciate your feedback and interest. Thank you for your attention to my work![/p]

notes.title: Stopping sales
notes.notes: [p]Unfortunately the game will not be finished and due to this I am going to stop sales.[/p][p][/p][p]I apologize to everyone who has been waiting for the game to be released in full version[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38478655/bdaa8e64e6fda5baff4846cefe1ee8fd89c18ba2.png"][/img][/p][p]Below I will post two locations that were never added.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38478655/37716dc8718d473c6215a88ab9023063c5b0d4e5.png"][/img][/p]
